name: Shared geometry under marginal-preserving correspondence corruption
label: PILOT/DEVELOPMENT
rationale: Clean shared-geometry pilot has not established a VCS advantage over matched BCE. This tests a specific bounded-loss robustness hypothesis under deliberately unreliable training correspondences; no positive result is assumed.

corruption.support: only aligned training descriptor pairs; CAL/DEV inputs and registration tasks unchanged
corruption.algorithm: Each scene and training step: independently choose m=round(rho*N) positions, cycle their right descriptors by one place. N=128, m=26 or51. No selected position stays fixed.
corruption.same_across_arms: RNG depends only on seed,step,scene,noise; it does not touch the host sampler or initialization RNG
corruption.marginals: right positions are permuted bijectively; both empirical marginals and full Q are exactly unchanged
corruption.P: joint with m/N mismatches, not the original clean joint. In expectation at fixed descriptors, P_noisy=(1-r)P_clean+r Q_offdiag, r=m/N.
corruption.Q: within-scene full empirical product, including diagonal. Conditional within-scene dependence, not global QMI.
corruption.theory: same mixture reference M=(P_noisy+Q)/2 and quadratic J over the stated noisy joint. Boundedness alone does not guarantee superior downstream robustness.

recipe.host: same normalized16D encoders, no free critic, original sampler
recipe.selection: same CAL loose success, strict success, median error, earlier checkpoint
recipe.secondary_readout: J_EXACT at the same selected model
recipe.clean_control: reuse frozen clean geometry jobs, all arms/all seeds; disclose GPU types

endpoints: clean DEV strict and loose success under corrupted training
VCS exact-minus-BCE and exact-minus-NCE at each declared noise level
difference in degradation versus matched controls; retain all seeds and both thresholds
VCS exact-minus-permutation isolates empirical reference computation
reporting: Two corruption levels reported separately; no posthoc winner selection. Current fixed LR and controlled artificial correspondence noise limit real-world claims.

execution.CPU_checks: bijection, mismatch count, same marginal moments, gradients, identical encoders
execution.GPU_smokes: BF rho.2 and EPFL rho.4 before bulk admission

_publication_note: Public scientific protocol excerpt; not an operational freeze, source manifest or admission authorization.
